grc:noun:μᾶζα.html:
μᾶζα, ἡ, (μάσσω, on the accent v. Hdn.Gr.; later μάζα Moer. P.)
barley-cake, , , , etc.; ἀμολγαίη; κυρβαίη (v.l.κυρκ-) ; φυστή: distd. from ἄρτος (wheaten bread), , cf. , , , , , ; μ. καὶ ὕδωρ; δουλίας μ. τυχεῖν to eat the bread of slavery, : prov., ἀγαθὴ καὶ μᾶζα μετ' ἄρτον, of second best things, ; μᾶζαν μεμαχώς having baked a cake, with a play on μάχην μεμαχημένος, .
generally, lump, mass, ball, , s.v.παλάθαι; χρυσοῦ , cf. : esp. in Alchemy, amalgam, ἀνέκλειπτος μ., .
grc:noun:μᾶζα.inflection: μᾶζα, ἡ, (μάσσω, on the accent v. Hdn.Gr.; later μάζα Moer. P.)

grc:name:Μαζάρης.gloss: a male given name, Mazares, from Old Persian, a Median general who defected to Cyrus the Great

grc:name:Μαζάκης.gloss: a male given name, Mazaces, from Old Persian, last satrap of Egypt

grc:name:Μαζαῖος.gloss: a male given name, Mazaeus, from Old Persian, a Persian nobleman and satrap of Babylon
